name: Generic FedRAMP Moderate (or higher) cloud service
description: Starting split for a SaaS or IaaS service authorized at FedRAMP Moderate or above that stores or processes CUI. Physical, environmental, maintenance and infrastructure controls sit with the provider; identity, data handling, training and incident coordination stay with or are shared by the customer.
disclaimer: Inheritance is only valid where the provider's authorization boundary actually covers the CUI in question at the required impact level. Confirm the authorization on the FedRAMP Marketplace, obtain the provider's Customer Responsibility Matrix, and reconcile every row of this template against it before relying on it in an assessment.

rows.provider_responsibility: The provider supplies and operates the underlying capability inside its authorization boundary and publishes the configuration options and audit data the customer needs.
rows.customer_responsibility: The customer configures the tenant-side settings, manages its own users and data, monitors the provider's audit output and evidences the customer-side portion.
